_what: #3810 (0da3b19a) made each eLumen award bind its own page. Antelope Valley's read 45574354887 and Redwoods' read 45574359765 then bound 38 and 2 programs to their own pages and held each one held_no_gain (held() in kb/_program_requirements_college.py): its filed record passes, and the own page names the same share of the listed courses, so the read did not extract it. The filed record, the one the live row holds, was read in run 38979725726 (38979396148 at Redwoods) from the sister award's page: a degree's record headed "Welding Cert", a certificate's headed "Electronics Technology AS" with the degree's 60 units and 21 of general education. No own-page record exists on main, so a step=reread (with or without its force, an extraction run id) has nothing of the own page to post: the own page has to be read, with force naming each program, since held() lets a forced control number through.
